description: Processed datasets: SWOT + ICESat-2 water balance study, Gezira Irrigation Scheme, Sudan (2023–2024) is a data set listed in DataCite country sweep of research-data repositories (Africa), a research data metadata index, published or maintained by Zenodo. Four processed output files supporting the manuscript submitted to GIScience & Remote Sensing. Coverage: Sudan. The portal files it under the publisher Zenodo. The repository dates the deposit 2026; no later update was checked. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support irrigation network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-dc-portal.
